text: Implemented a global sufficient small-strain certificate using sum |c_k| sup ||D psi_k|| with directed arithmetic allowance; transformed mode bounds include the rigid/affine gauge-projection derivative. The certificate also records padded-domain amplitude, coefficient hash, basis/gauge/extension/revision, checked pose determinant/singular values, and conservative composite singular-value and determinant bounds. Added contraction fixed-point inversion with the physical residual/(1-kappa) a posteriori error bound, explicit forward/reverse domains, iteration limit, and typed failures. Added the geometry operator with certificate checks on map/JVP/VJP/propose and typed inverseMap; it uses reusable operator-owned scratch. Evidence strings distinguish the certificate and inverse from sampled topology, SmoothIso, and negated-displacement shortcuts. Independent tests validate sampled analytic Jacobians against global and composite bounds, reject above-limit coefficients, close forward/inverse residual to 2.5e-8 mm near the configured gradient limit including a padded-extension point, and cover typed iteration/domain failure. Gates: affected JVM suites 9/9; Scala.js 9/9; strict Werror compile; git diff --check clean. Numerical evidence is implementation correctness, not anatomical accuracy.
